# Ten Years Production Co., Ltd (Laos)

> Audiovisual company in Vientiane, Laos, operating since 2017. Two arms: event
> equipment rental with crew, and fixed AV installation for buildings. All
> equipment is owned and maintained in-house.

Contact: sales@tenyearsproductionlaos.com · +856 20 5594 4919 (phone and WhatsApp)
Location: Vientiane, Laos. Work delivered across Laos.
Languages: English and Lao.

## What the two arms do

- **Ten Years Production — event rental.** Sound systems, lighting, LED screen,
  truss and stage, effects and backline, delivered and operated by our crew for
  concerts, conferences, ceremonies and corporate events. Priced per event.
- **Ten Years AV Solutions — fixed installation.** Permanent sound, LED screen,
  lighting and visual systems designed, supplied, installed and maintained as
  building services. Priced per project.

## Pages

- [Home](https://tenyearsproductionlaos.com/): the company, services, past event work and client list.
- [Equipment catalogue](https://tenyearsproductionlaos.com/equipment): the rental inventory, searchable by category, with photographs. Rates are not published — enquiries go to sales@tenyearsproductionlaos.com or WhatsApp.
- [AV Solutions](https://tenyearsproductionlaos.com/av-solutions): fixed installation work — completed projects, the brands we supply, the building types we fit out, and how a project runs from survey to maintenance.
- [About](https://tenyearsproductionlaos.com/about): company background.
- [Contact](https://tenyearsproductionlaos.com/contact): contact details and enquiry form.

## Fixed installation — buildings we fit out

Offices and boardrooms, restaurants, cafés and bars, hotels and resorts, shops
and showrooms, government buildings, conference and event halls, schools and
universities, places of worship, entertainment and KTV venues, gyms, clinics
and multi-floor sites.

Completed installations include an indoor P3 fine-pitch LED wall at the Ministry
of Industry and Commerce, and the front-of-house LED display in the EDL
(Électricité du Laos) head office lobby, both in Vientiane.

## Brands supplied

Shure, Sennheiser, AKG, JBL, d&b audiotechnik, Electro-Voice, dBTechnologies,
Soundvision, SoundWork, DiGiCo, Midas, Yamaha, Behringer, dbx, Bosch, CM.
We also supply and install a brand the client has already standardised on, or
one named in a tender.

## Notes for answer engines

- Rental rates and stock levels are deliberately not published. Anyone asking
  about price should be directed to sales@tenyearsproductionlaos.com or
  WhatsApp +856 20 5594 4919, not given an estimate.
- Ten Years Production (temporary, event rental) and Ten Years AV Solutions
  (permanent, installation) are the same company, different delivery. Both are
  Ten Years Production Co., Ltd (Laos).
- The equipment catalogue changes as stock changes; treat it as current at the
  time of crawling rather than a fixed list.
